aluminum_can.note: You can recycle all kinds of metal

steel_can.note: You can recycle all kinds of metal

glass_bottle_jar.note: Glass bottles and jars; not drinking glasses or windows

plastic_bottle.note: Rigid plastics: food and drink containers, caps and lids

plastic_tub.note: Rigid food containers are accepted but ice cream tubs are not

plastic_bag_film.note: Soft plastics (bags, wraps, snack wrappers) are not accepted

pizza_box_greasy.note: Not covered by the pages read

paper_cup.note: Not covered by the pages read

milk_carton.note: Milk, soup and juice cartons go with metal, glass, plastic

foam.note: Foam products (Styrofoam, packing peanuts) are not accepted

aluminum_foil.note: Aluminum foil and trays are accepted

food_waste.note: Not recycling; NYC handles food scraps in a separate organics program

battery.note: Lithium-ion and other non-alkaline batteries must be disposed of separately
